newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, nearbys gain.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, nearbys gain.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed, with nearbys gaining on grain transportation delays and bullish export sales data, traders said.
USDA said Friday that net wheat export sales during the week ended Jan 16 totaled 590,900 tonnes, above expectations of 200,000 to 300,000 tonnes.
Spring wheat also drew support from the weather-related transportation headaches in the northern U.S. Plains.
"We had snow and high winds up in the Dakotas again yesterday. What I'm hearing is they think it's going to take a few days before we get cars coming in again," a trader said.
MGE spring wheat closed 1/4 cent per bushel lower to 1-1/2 cents higher, with March up 1-1/2 cents at $3.89-3/4.
Traders said the transportation woes continued to force the March/May spread to widen. The spread traded Friday at 20-1/2 cents, after trading late Thursday at 19 cents.

"The millers continue to be better buyers of the spread. Bay State Milling came in a couple of days ago paying 17 cents for a bunch of the spread. General Mills came in today and paid 20-1/2," a trader said.
MGE barley futures did not trade and settled unchanged.
